title: Scruffy regression bits - quick lab notes
content:
Purpose / context:
- Quick scratchpad to capture the odd regression I bumped into while spot-checking nightly samples for convo-model-x. Not a polished writeup — crib notes for follow up.

High-level symptom:
- Small but consistent change in punctuation and list formatting in multi-turn replies after the 2025-10-28 model rollout. Notably: extra trailing commas, dropped conjunctions ("and" -> removed), and occasional duplicated bullets when system prompt includes a short enumerated list.

Why this matters:
- Downstream clients parse bulleted lists and tables with a lightweight heuristic. Extra commas + duplicates cause 3rd-party parsers to classify responses as "malformed" -> degrades UX and triggers fallback rules. Seen 12% higher fallback for a subset of low-latency routes (p95 latency < 90ms) on yesterday's traffic.

Quick hypothesis list (ranked):
1) Tokenizer change: subtle token merges/splits around punctuation after the rollout; model sampling interacts and emits extra commas.
2) Decoding / sampling tweak (top-p/top-k/temperature default tweak) applied during rollout to reduce hallucinations might be causing list instability.
3) Prompt truncation / prefix caching bug: KV cache reuse for short system prompts sometimes leaves an extra comma token from prior request.
4) Post-processing clean-up stage (strip-trailing-punct) was disabled for certain shards during deploy.

Mini-repro recipe (what I ran locally):
- Model: convo-model-x@2025-10-28 (prod variant)
- Few-shot prompt: system + 3-shot examples with explicit dashes and numbering, last user asks "Give 3 quick steps"
- Settings: temperature=0.2, top_p=0.9, max_tokens=180, streaming=false
- Observed outputs (samples):
  * Sample A (expected):
    1. Open settings
    2. Toggle feature
    3. Restart app

  * Sample B (regression):
    1. Open settings,
    2. Toggle feature,
    3. Restart app,

  * Sample C (weird duplicate):
    - Open settings
    - Toggle feature
    - Toggle feature
    - Restart app

Notes on repro variability:
- Deterministic seed reduces frequency but doesn't eliminate the issue.
- Higher temperature increases duplication rate (expected).
- Lowering top_p to 0.6 reduced stray commas in one run; inconsistent.

Ad-hoc rubric for triage (1–5, 5 worst):
- Impact on parsing: 4
- Frequency in production traffic (sampled): 3
- Ease of repro: 2
- Risk to rollback: 2
- Time to root cause (est): 1–3 days

Immediate checks for next 24h:
- Run a token-level diff between pre-rollout and post-rollout outputs for the same prompt set (small batch of 1000 prompts).
- Filter logs for requests using prefix caching and inspect KV hits for punctuation tokens.
- Push a targeted A/B (5% traffic) that forces classical post-strip step before returning results to see drop in fallback rate.

Longer-term diagnostics to follow:
- Re-run reproducer across multiple model variants (quantized vs fp16) to isolate kernel vs model behaviour.
- Add micro-metric: fraction of responses ending in punctuation sequence ",\n" or ",
" and abnormal duplicate consecutive list items. Add to nightly eval dashboard.

Possible quick mitigations (short list):
- Re-enable or re-run lightweight post-processing that cleans trailing commas and collapses consecutive duplicate list items. Low-risk and reversible.
- Force deterministic decode/logging for affected routes for 24h to collect higher quality traces.
- If tokenizer delta confirmed, revert tokenizer mapping or pin model variant that matches old tokenization.

Observations for engineering handoff:
- I captured a few raw payloads (attached to Linear BUG-4821) from production that show both trailing commas and duplicates.
- The anomaly tends to appear more on requests with short system instructions and long user context (~>600 tokens). Might indicate cache spillover.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Did the rollout include any subtle tokenizer updates or detokenizer post-processing changes? (ask infra/runtime).
- Are there concurrent changes in request batching that could change how prompts are concatenated?
- Is any new micro-optimisation in the serving runtime changing token boundaries for streamed outputs?

Immediate TODOs (me / next 48h):
- [ ] Run token-diff job (1000 prompts) vs snapshot from 2025-10-20 (I will run locally and push results to BUG-4821).
- [ ] Add quick metric in nightly eval (Noah can wire this into the eval pipeline).
- [ ] Prototype post-processing hook: strip trailing comma across list boundaries (Maya to prototype).
- [ ] Ping infra + runtime owners for deploy changelog (quick Slack: #runtime-deployments).

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc terse. If RCA points to runtime, expand into a proper postmortem.
- Remember to annotate any saved outputs with request id + model variant + shard id to make tracing easier.

Scratch / stray thoughts:
- Could also be an interaction with the streaming code path where a chunk boundary ends with a comma and the next chunk repeats it. Check framed streaming boundaries.
- If it's cache spillover, maybe a simple slot-clearing on context boundaries could reduce frequency at expense of cost.

End.
